hints.title: Powers of Five Set
hints.text: Precompute binary representations of powers of five up to string length limits.

hints.title: Prefix Partitioning
hints.text: At each index, check all prefixes that form valid binary representations of powers of five without leading zeros.

hints.title: Subproblem Minimization
hints.text: Determine the minimum partition count to complete the remainder of the string.

hints.title: Binary Partition DP

variables: n: length of binary string s (n <= 15)
complexity.notes: Small string length allows quadratic subproblem exploration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force exponential partitioning tests invalid non-power prefixes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear table records optimal cuts from each index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Validates binary powers of five and implements linear subproblem recurrence.
